hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-serif font-semibold text-[#183935]

grids_and_layouts.parent_portal: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, playback controls, status indicators) MUST have data-testid in kebab-case.

3d_libraries.use_case: Not required for core video therapy workflow. Rely on high-clarity video player, HTML canvas for video recording preview, and CSS micro-animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Integrate Therapist Home Video Recording & Upload Modal / Drawer into Staff.jsx.

Implement child selection, therapy step bullet points (e.g. 1-3 step breakdown), target duration (5-10 mins max), camera/video recorder web-RTC simulation or local file picker preview, and publication to parent portal.
Add Parent Notification Center & Home Therapy Videos feed into Parent.jsx with date badges, read/unread state updates, step-by-step checklist for parents, therapist history, and video modal viewer.
Provide Therapist Edit / Delete capabilities for assigned home video exercises.
Ensure all buttons and inputs include rigorous data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid full-screen plain dark gradients; maintain the warm care-oriented light theme of Moonlight Neurocare.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to prevent text collision.
Use explicitly declared text color on hover and focus states.
Respect responsive mobile-first patterns with generous spacing.
